hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .path // ""' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then CONTENT=$(cat "$FILE"); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "FileChanged", "additionalContext": "LARRY — new task file dropped in Team Inbox.
File: %s
Contents:
%s

Please read this task, identify the right team member, and action it."}}
' "$FILE" "$CONTENT"; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: LARRY picking up new Team Inbox task...
